suites.title: Student exam depth audit with isolated temporary records

specs.title: timed expiry rejects late answers and ignores queued changes while preserving saved answers
resuming an expired timed exam automatically submits and renders the persisted result
invalid UUID and foreign question payloads cannot change the current attempt
unanswered exam confirmation supports cancel and explicit zero-score submission
exam list search, completion filters and pagination keep counts and rows consistent
S-N01 student direct routes, aliases, reload, mobile and console evidence
S-N02 anonymous protected route and server endpoints reject access
S-N03 quiz search and result export/print use real student records
S-N04 missing quiz back navigation stays in authorized student panel
